output.reason: Evidence shows that RBI’s earlier pre-payment/foreclosure charge directions have been withdrawn and are not in force as of 2026-11-23: (1) “RBI (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025” was repealed with effect from 2025-11-28 and is no longer in force on 2026-11-23 (listed in the “Circulars Withdrawn” annex); and (2) “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans (2014)” was withdrawn/repealed effective 2026-01-01 and is also no longer in force on 2026-11-23 (listed in the repeal annex). Therefore, these earlier RBI directions do not control as of the stated date.
